passcode.description: EDOPro/ocgcore card code. For official cards this is the printed 8-digit passcode; historical overrides use custom codes outside the official range.

cardRef.description: A reference to a card. Both passcode and name are stored deliberately: the validator cross-checks them against the card index so single-field typos are caught.

name.description: English card name as of the data snapshot (modern EDOPro name unless stated otherwise).

sourceRefs.description: IDs resolving to entries in the global data/sources.json registry or the format-local sources.json. Every factual record must cite at least one source.

region.description: Which side of the game's split rules/card-pool history this record belongs to.

implementationStatus.description: missing: not started. stub: placeholder exists. partial: usable but incomplete. complete: believed complete. verified: complete and cross-checked against at least two independent sources or an executable test.
